processing_steps.method: vacuum induction casting in a 100 kW vacuum induction furnace

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Applied to the hot-rolled 5 mm flat-products to give the as-received/reference condition.

structures.overall_structure: Equilibrium phase constitution of the 9Al-10Mn-0.4 composition taken from the phase volume fraction diagram (Fig. 9(a)); the as-hot-rolled (as-received) state corresponds to the 1150 °C equilibria. Equilibrium phases reported over 0–1300 °C are BCC_A2 (δ-ferrite), FCC_A1 (austenite) and KAPPA_E21 (κ-carbide). No micrograph of the as-hot-rolled 9Al-10Mn-0.4C is provided.

phases_present.volume_fraction: ~0.87–0.92 mol below ~700 °C; minimum ~0.51 mol at 800 °C; ~0.28 mol at 1300 °C
near zero up to ~700 °C; ~0.49 mol at 800 °C; declining to ~0.28 mol at 1300 °C

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Through-thickness embedding, grinding and polishing performed separately for hot-rolled and heat-treated samples
characterization_methods.purpose: Microstructural analysis of the alloys at the different processing conditions

characterization_methods.technique: Scanning electron microscopy (Secondary Electron Images, SEI) and Energy Dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX/EDS)
characterization_methods.purpose: Analysis of phase morphologies and local chemical compositions

computational_details.simulation_method: CALPHAD thermodynamic equilibrium calculation (phase volume fraction diagram)
computational_details.validation_against_experiment: Used qualitatively to explain austenite stability: for 9Al-10Mn-0.4 the γ (FCC_A1) volume fraction does not decrease at 800 °C compared with 1150 °C, consistent with the reported absence of austenite decomposition at 800 °C and the occurrence of discontinuous precipitation at 600 °C.

unmapped_findings: Sample composition (wt%): Al 9, Mn 10, C 0.4, Fe balance; this composition falls within the tested Fe–Mn–Al–C grade ranges of Table 1 (Al 9–12, Mn 10–20–30, C 0.4–1, Fe bal.).

No Vickers hardness value is tabulated for the 9Al-10Mn-0.4C composition in any condition; Tables 2, 4, 5, 8 and 9 report hardness only for 9Al-10Mn-1C, 12Al-10Mn-1C, 12Al-20Mn-1C, 12Al-30Mn-1C, 9Al-20Mn-1C and 9Al-30Mn-1C.

The reported microstructure of the 9Al-10Mn-0.4C alloy (only partial discontinuous precipitation of austenite into γ + κ lamellar structures, the reaction starting at the grain boundaries; Fig. 1(a) and Fig. 2(a)) is measured after 600 °C tempering and therefore belongs to the 600 °C tempered sample, not to this as-hot-rolled (1150 °C) sample. The paper additionally states the 9Al-10Mn-0.4C alloy did not undergo austenite decomposition during tempering at 800 °C.
